last_result.headline: Q54 closed hard global path constraints. HEADLINE: at the optimal lam=60 the DP path deviates +-3.0 ft from the anchor while the TRUTH deviates +-19.4 -- the DP is OVER-DAMPED, not under-constrained, so a corridor can only restrict it further and one tight enough to bind would exclude the truth. Corridor and penalty are SUBSTITUTES: at lam=5 the corridor rescues +3.12 to the level lambda alone reaches, but best combined 12.138 vs 12.170 lambda-only. Nested +0.031, helps 2.5% of wells (lowest in the project), 3-well 5th -0.518. Also caught N1s inert-constraint trap via a binding diagnostic. The transition model is now closed across soft penalties, per-step bounds and global corridors; with Q17 the alignment line is boxed from both sides.
